verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's Data API offers a single interface for identity, accounts, transactions and balances (docs-28, docs-5). Verification works across all accounts the user consented to (docs-29), and one flow can combine onboarding with a first payment (docs-7). That points to one connection serving several data products, but the evidence never says that a single consent or auth session covers all of them without separate flows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that one auth link or consent grants multiple scopes (identity, balances, transactions) at once, guidance on scope or permission selection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
